videos.script: Lesson five chose technologies. This one is about structure. {{title}} How a system is cut into parts, how the parts talk, and who owns which data. These decisions outlive any product you pick. {{five}} Not every one of them needs an architect. We will use three tests. Is it expensive to reverse? Does it cross a team? Does it set a quality several teams depend on? {{tests}} Then the trade-offs. Every structural choice buys one quality by spending another. And a requirement like payments must be reliable cannot settle anything. {{reliable}} So we write it as a scenario in six parts, with a number at the end that someone can check. {{scenario}} Last, a decision with five criteria and three options. Where should shipper invoicing live at Carreto? {{matrix}} A weighted matrix says the monolith. Then we move one weight and watch the winner change. {{sensitivity}} That crossing point is the real argument, and it belongs to the people who own each side. Renata does not choose. She makes the decision decidable. {{close}}
